knownDefectsFixed: The bootstrap status?tab&doc read raced the window's own parked wait: one document registering twice minted a second record that forced a false no_response. The parked record is now reused when tab and doc both match (Chromium's Duplicate Tab copies the tab id but mints a new doc).

A held browser-mode window was answered with settled{held:true}, leaving it between polls when it left; its departure was never observed and the clean pagehide claim was never discharged, leaking maintenance. Browser mode now keeps the wait parked while the hold is on.
